source: seed/seed-sheet.csv is a blank 21-row template filled by the operator; seed/seed-sheet-示例.csv is a 3-row worked example generated for this repo.
caveat: These files are not site capture and not a population sample. The blank template cannot support any conclusion until every row is filled and graded; the worked example is synthetic and is only a format check.

files.source: blank operator template written by seed/grade.js
files.caveat: Blank by design: 21 empty rows are a prompt to the operator, not coverage. Do not read WAIT 0/21 as a measured result.

files.source: 3-row syntax example generated for this repo
files.caveat: Three hand-sized rows demonstrate the CSV columns only. They are not a sample of any backlog and must not be pooled with site data.
